Diego R.: Morning! On day two and running through onboarding. Quick questions: 1) My laptop MDM enrolled but I still see 'FileVault Off'. 2) When do I get access to the internal conjur vault? 3) Phishing sim schedule?

it-bot: Hi Diego  ticket IT-5068 created and assigned to eng-infra. To check disk: `sudo fdesetup status`. For vault access, confirm security training completion.

security-ops: Welcome Diego. Short answers: we enable disk encryption via MDM; don't enable via iCloud. Vault (conjur) access is gated: must finish Security Awareness training + sign the data-handling acknowledgement. Phishing sims are automatic; you'll be enrolled and get simulated emails within 1-2 weeks of start.

Diego R.: Got it. On the training: I haven't received the email from trainings@redwood. I checked spam.

Maya (People Ops): Sorry about that  I'll re-trigger the invite now. If you still don't get it in 15 mins, reply here and I'll create a manual enrollment.

Nina L.: Also FYI if you need emergency vault creds for a demo, we can grant a short-lived dev token after manual approval. That still requires a quick 1:1 review with security.

Diego R.: Can confirm `sudo fdesetup status` shows 'FileVault is Off'. Attaching output to IT-5068.

security-ops: Thanks. We'll check MDM logs. If needed we'll force an MDM policy push to enable FileVault and escrow keys to KMS. ETA ~3 hours.

Maya (People Ops): Training invite sent again. Check trainings@redwood and trainings.redwood.com inbox. I'll monitor and update this thread when you complete it.

Diego R.: One last policy Q  I occasionally work from a home NAS for backups. Are backups of company data allowed to personal cloud/NAS?

security-ops: No company data on personal cloud or NAS unless explicitly approved and encrypted with company-managed keys. Use company backup solutions only. If you need to back up local dev artifacts, request an exception and we'll provide an approved workflow.

Diego R.: Thanks all  I'll wait on the MDM push and complete the training. Appreciate the help :thumbsup:

it-bot: IT-5068 updated: assigned to @eng-infra, priority standard.
